SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO AS paymentMethodNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, PAYMENT_TYPE AS paymentType, BANK_CODE AS bankCode,
CASE BANK_CODE WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한은행' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민은행' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리은행' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협은행' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나은행' WHEN 'KAKAO' THEN '카카오뱅크' WHEN 'TOSS' THEN '토스뱅크' ELSE BANK_CODE END AS bankName,
ACCOUNT_LAST4 AS accountLast4, ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS accountHolder, PAYMENT_DEFAULT AS paymentDefault
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PAYMENT_TYPE = 'BANK'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO AS paymentMethodNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, PAYMENT_TYPE AS paymentType,
CASE CARD_COMPANY WHEN 'BC' THEN '비씨카드' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민카드' WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한카드' WHEN 'SAMSUNG' THEN '삼성카드' WHEN 'HYUNDAI' THEN '현대카드' WHEN 'LOTTE' THEN '롯데카드' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나카드' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리카드' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협카드' ELSE CARD_COMPANY END AS cardCompany,
CARD_LAST4 AS cardLast4, PAYMENT_DEFAULT AS paymentDefault
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PAYMENT_TYPE = 'CARD'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO AS paymentMethodNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, PAYMENT_TYPE AS paymentType, BANK_CODE AS bankCode,
CASE BANK_CODE WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한은행' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민은행' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리은행' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협은행' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나은행' WHEN 'KAKAO' THEN '카카오뱅크' WHEN 'TOSS' THEN '토스뱅크' ELSE BANK_CODE END AS bankName,
ACCOUNT_LAST4 AS accountLast4, ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS accountHolder, CARD_COMPANY AS cardCompany, CARD_LAST4 AS cardLast4, PAYMENT_DEFAULT AS paymentDefault
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PAYMENT_METHOD_NO DESC
